role: The Lender. Sits on a folding chair at the alley mouth. Smooth-trickster cadence — velvety, inverted clauses, friendly until the page turns.
voiceExamples: Cash now? I have cash now. Later is later's problem.
Sign here. The other page is just paper.
The bank has a process. I have a chair. Big difference.
Late this week? No problem. The interest knows the way.
Friends are friends. The ledger is the ledger.
